senses.zh_definition: 专有名称，通常写作 Elsa，常用作女性名字，可音译为“埃尔莎”等；输入中的具体所指尚未确定。
senses.en_definition: A proper name, conventionally capitalized Elsa, commonly used as a feminine given name; its referent here is unspecified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama perempuan dan dieja Elsa; rujukan khusus dalam input ini belum dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 这是一项明确标注的专名解释，不能冒充已核实的 DBP 普通词条；马来文释义为编辑说明。下面的搭配是姓名使用示例，不是已验证的高频固定搭配。瑞典语言与民俗研究所将 Elsa 列为 Elisabet 的昵称形式之一。[Isof：Elisabet](https://www.isof.se/utforska/kunskapsbanker/lar-dig-mer-om-arets-namn-och-handelser/namn/elisabet)

etymology.historical_story: Elsa belongs to a European personal-name tradition. Sweden's Institute for Language and Folklore identifies it as a familiar form of Elisabet, alongside names such as Elise and Lisa. That relationship explains a naming history, not a Malay lexical meaning. Without the original sentence, the lowercase input cannot identify a particular person, character, or other namesake. [Isof: Elisabet](https://www.isof.se/utforska/kunskapsbanker/lar-dig-mer-om-arets-namn-och-handelser/namn/elisabet)
